The 60hz frozen budget is not met in the current headless-Chrome integrated-GPU adapter state (p95 20.3 ms); an A/B control at HEAD shows identical frame times, so this is an environment/adapter limitation, not a regression. Dev-profile budget (p95 <= 100 ms) passes; FAB-02 entry passes.

Interactive flows (in-session FAB switch, device-lost, tour, wafer, picking, camera input) were not replayed end-to-end in a real browser this round; device-lost recovery remains covered by E2 tests only.
GPU adapter identity is not exposed by the project perf bridge; this report used a separate CDP probe and recorded the adapter state.
Correctness audit is differential/static (E1) plus E2 tests; it does not prove behavior under unrecorded interactive flows.
git diff --cached --check flags only the imported standard Markdown hard-break lines; code changes are clean.

During final browser verification the local dev server on 5173 was disrupted by deleting node_modules/.vite under the running process; it was restored (stale Vite stopped, cache cleared, detached restart) and re-verified in Chrome. No product code was affected.
